caption:
Nitish built an autonomous coding agent. You give it one problem statement; a six-node pipeline plans the project, writes the files, scans them for unsafe code, runs them in a sandbox and sends every crash back to a debugger for a fix, up to three times. Two small 4B models run locally with llama-server, so the cloud bill is $0. His LangSmith log: 91 of 96 benchmark runs passed.

Live demo: https://ultimate-coding-agent-by-x-estal-nitish.streamlit.app/
Code: https://github.com/XestalNitish/ultimate-coding-agent

Send this to the friend who pastes tracebacks into a chat window all day.
